hook.text: Our Father told Moses, "I AM WHO I AM." Then he said, "Tell the Israelites: 'I AM has sent me to you.'"
father: "Tell the Israelites: 'I AM has sent me to you.'"
hook.note: This is Volume 1's territory — Genesis through Esther, where our Father does most of His speaking in the whole Bible. In every other Bible His answer to Moses is the same black ink as the verse around it. Here it is BLUE, set in 14-point type on a single column across the page. You do not have to lean in to find Him.

short350: You have wanted a Father your whole life. Not a doctrine about Him. Not a distant power. A Father — His voice, His heart turned toward you.

Father's Heart Bible is the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking: our Father's words in BLUE, the Son's in RED, the Spirit's in PURPLE. For a hundred and twenty-five years, red letters have shown the Son speaking. Across the whole Bible our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies.

This is Volume 1 of the three-volume Large Print edition: the Old Testament, Genesis through Esther, 17 books in full text — 436 chapters and 12,869 verses, not abridged. In this volume our Father speaks 50,700 words across 2,416 verses, every one set apart in BLUE. The color marks ownership, not quotation: His words stay His on any lips that carry them faithfully, words He never spoke are never colored, and narration stays black.

Set in 14-point type in a single column across the page, so every line reads whole and poetry keeps its shape. Most Bibles labelled large print are 10 to 12 point, and the ones that go bigger force the whole Bible into a single volume on thin paper — ghosting the text through from the other side, and too heavy to hold open. Three volumes on opaque 50lb white paper answer both. And the large print does more than enlarge the words: Divine Voice Color shows you who is speaking, so it serves your ear as well as your eye. An introduction opens each book, a Father's note closes each with a short prayer, and 442 notes serve the reader, not the scholar. The full opening pages — Abba Father, a message from Kevin and Shelly, Receiving Your Father, the Preface and About this Translation — are in every volume. A presentation page carries their name.
He is not distant. He is not disappointed. He is your Heavenly Father, and He delights in you as His beloved child.
A fresh translation from the original Hebrew, Aramaic, and Greek. The three volumes together carry the complete Bible — 66 books, 1,189 chapters, 31,085 verses. A gift, a keepsake, an heirloom.
Receive the Father. Hear His voice. His heart is for you.

body: Father's Heart Bible™ (FHB) Large Print, Volume 1: the Old Testament, Genesis through Esther. A color coded Bible set in 14-point type in a single column for comfortable reading — the first Bible in print where you can see who is speaking.
Our Father's words in BLUE. The Son's words in RED. The Spirit's words in PURPLE.
In this volume our Father speaks 50,700 words across 2,416 verses, every one set apart in BLUE.

For a hundred and twenty-five years, the red letter Bible has shown you the Son speaking. Across the whole Bible our Father speaks more than three times as often — 128,579 words across 5,615 verses — and every one of them has been printed in the same black ink as the genealogies. He has been speaking the whole time. No Bible has ever shown you where.
God is our Father. Not a role He plays. Father is who He is, and Father is His name, the name Jesus came to reveal: "I revealed your name to those you gave me from the world" (John 17:6).

If the word father is not a word of comfort for you, this Bible is especially for you. The Father revealed here is no projection of broken human fatherhood. He is the original, from whom every family in heaven and on earth takes its name.

faq.a: Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, Judges, Ruth, 1 and 2 Samuel, 1 and 2 Kings, 1 and 2 Chronicles, Ezra, Nehemiah and Esther — 17 books in full text, 436 chapters, 12,869 verses. Nothing is abridged, summarized or left out.

faq.q: Do I need all three volumes?
faq.a: Only if you want the whole Bible. Volume 1 is Genesis–Esther in Wheat, Volume 2 is Job–Malachi in Sage, and Volume 3 is the New Testament in Mist Blue. Each stands on its own and each carries the full opening pages, so a single volume is a complete book to read — not a fragment.

faq.q: How large is the print, really?
faq.a: True 14 point, set in a single column across the page. Most Bibles sold as large print are 10 to 12 point in two narrow columns. The type here is bigger and the line is wider, which is why this volume runs 1,134 pages.

Both are offered, 6 x 9, in the Wheat cover. Paperback (ISBN 979-8-89307-339-3) if you are going to carry it and mark it; hardback (ISBN 979-8-89307-343-0) if it is a gift or it is going on a shelf for years. The interior is identical — 1,134 pages, full color throughout.

faq.q: How is this different from the regular 6 x 9 edition?
faq.a: They are different books. The regular edition is the complete Bible in one volume at standard type size. This is the same translation set at 14 point in a single column, which takes three volumes to hold. Choose large print for readability; choose the single volume if you want the whole Bible in one book.
